user.title: Geely Connect
user.description:
Unofficial community integration - not affiliated with Geely. Enter your Geely account email and pick your country, and we'll send a 6-digit code to your inbox.

Polling mode decides how often the car is contacted. Geely allows one session per account, so every poll briefly signs the phone app out - pick Manual if that bothers you.

code.title: Enter the code from your inbox
code.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Paste it here.

pick_vehicle.title: Pick a vehicle
pick_vehicle.description: Your Geely account has multiple vehicles. Pick the one to add. Already-configured vehicles are not shown.

init.title: Options
init.description:
Change how often Home Assistant polls the car, the tire-pressure unit and which entities are exposed.

Eco, Normal and Live poll on a timer, from least to most often. Manual never polls on its own: data refreshes only when you press the Refresh Data button, call homeassistant.update_entity, or send a command to the car. Nothing is contacted in between, so the phone app stays signed in - but values stay as old as your last sync.

data.full_exposure: Expose every raw field (adds ~180 diagnostic entities)
